model_result.answer_summary: L is the 1,4-diol of otherwise fully O-benzylated beta-cyclodextrin: clockwise units 1-7 are CH2OH, CH2OBn, CH2OBn, CH2OH, CH2OBn, CH2OBn, CH2OBn, and the fourteen secondary sites are (OBn)14.
assumptions: The problem statement defines beta-CD as seven alpha-D-glucopyranoside units, and the Q9-3 starting template displays seven primary CH2OH groups plus fourteen secondary OH groups.
The displayed 30 equivalents each of NaH and BnCl are interpreted by the standard Williamson O-benzylation rule as exhaustive benzylation of all 21 hydroxyl groups.
The displayed two-equivalent DIBAL-H operation is interpreted as the two sequential primary reductive debenzylations discussed by the paragraph immediately above the scheme.
The first exposed position is named unit 1 using the cyclic symmetry of fully benzylated beta-CD; the problem-stated directing rule then selects available unit 4 for the next primary debenzylation.
The displayed O-benzylation and primary O-debenzylation steps do not break bonds at the alpha-D-glucopyranoside stereocentres.
